failure.body:
**Description**
In minigraph.py:
```
            if vintf.find(str(QName(ns, "DhcpRelays"))) is not None:
                vintfdhcpservers = vintf.find(str(QName(ns, "DhcpRelays"))).text
                vdhcpserver_list = vintfdhcpservers.split(';')
                vlan_attributes['dhcp_servers'] = vdhcpserver_list

```
This will crash upon case of `<DhcpRelays></DhcpRelays>`, i.e. `vintf.find(str(QName(ns, "DhcpRelays"))) is not None` but `vintf.find(str(QName(ns, "DhcpRelays"))).text is None`.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
Create a minigraph with `<DhcpRelays></DhcpRelays>` in `<VlanInterface>` section, then `sonic-cfggen -m`.

resolution.title: [sonic-cfggen]: Fix minigraph DhcpRelays parsing issue
resolution.description:
**- What I did**
Add additional check to fix https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/1302

**- How I did it**
I check .text attribute is not None before using it.

**- How to verify it**
Use sonic-cfggen with minigraph, where DhcpRelays are empty:
`<DhcpRelays></DhcpRelays>`
